documents.title: 2.1 Device Inventory
documents.official_text_preview: Maintain an inventory of authorized devices. Device inventory supports authorization decisions. Unknown devices are denied or quarantined.

documents.title: 2.2 Device Detection and Compliance
documents.official_text_preview: Detect devices and assess compliance posture. Non-compliant devices are identified. Non-compliant devices are blocked or remediated.

documents.title: 2.3 Device Authorization with Real Time Inspection
documents.official_text_preview: Authorize devices using real-time inspection. Device health informs every access request. Unhealthy devices are denied access.

documents.title: 2.4 Remote Access
documents.official_text_preview: Secure remote access to enterprise resources. Remote sessions meet zero trust requirements. Untrusted remote access is denied.

documents.official_text_preview: Automate asset, vulnerability, and patch management. Assets are patched and vulnerabilities managed at scale. Unpatched assets are restricted.

documents.official_text_preview: Manage endpoints and mobile devices consistently. Enterprise endpoint management is unified. Unmanaged endpoints are denied.

documents.title: 2.7 Endpoint and Extended Detection and Response

documents.title: 3.1 Application Inventory
documents.official_text_preview: Inventory applications and workloads. Applications are visible and authorized. Unknown applications are blocked or removed.

documents.title: 3.2 Secure Software Development and Integration
documents.official_text_preview: Integrate secure development practices. Applications are developed and integrated securely. Insecure software is remediated before deployment.

documents.title: 3.3 Software Risk Management
documents.official_text_preview: Manage software supply chain and component risk. Software risk is assessed and tracked. High-risk software is blocked or mitigated.

documents.title: 3.4 Resource Authorization and Integration
documents.official_text_preview: Authorize application and workload resources. Resources are authorized before access is granted. Unauthorized resources are denied.

documents.title: 3.5 Continuous Monitoring and Ongoing Authorizations

documents.title: 4.1 Data Catalog Risk Alignment
documents.official_text_preview: Align data catalogs with risk management. Data assets are cataloged with risk context. Uncataloged sensitive data is discovered and protected.

documents.title: 4.2 DoD Enterprise Data Governance
documents.official_text_preview: Govern data across the enterprise. Enterprise data governance is established. Ungoverned data flows are restricted.

documents.title: 4.3 Data Labeling and Tagging
documents.official_text_preview: Label and tag data for protection decisions. Data is labeled consistently. Unlabeled sensitive data is remediated.

documents.title: 4.4 Data Monitoring and Sensing
documents.official_text_preview: Monitor data access and movement. Data usage is visible in near real time. Anomalous data access triggers response.

documents.title: 4.5 Data Encryption and Rights Management
documents.official_text_preview: Encrypt data and enforce rights management. Sensitive data is encrypted and rights-managed. Unprotected sensitive data is blocked or encrypted.

documents.title: 4.6 Data Loss Prevention
documents.official_text_preview: Prevent unauthorized data exfiltration. DLP controls are deployed enterprise-wide. Data exfiltration attempts are blocked.

documents.title: 4.7 Data Access Control
documents.official_text_preview: Control access to data based on policy. Data access follows least privilege. Unauthorized data access is denied.

documents.title: 5.1 Data Flow Mapping
documents.official_text_preview: Map data flows across the environment. Data flows are documented and monitored. Unknown flows are restricted.

documents.title: 5.2 Software Defined Networking
documents.official_text_preview: Use SDN for dynamic network policy. Network policy is software defined. Static overly permissive paths are removed.

documents.title: 5.3 Macro Segmentation
documents.official_text_preview: Segment the network at macro boundaries. Macro segments limit lateral movement. Cross-segment access requires authorization.

documents.title: 5.4 Micro Segmentation
documents.official_text_preview: Apply fine-grained network segmentation. Micro segments enforce least privilege network access. Unnecessary east-west traffic is denied.

documents.title: 6.1 API Standardization
documents.official_text_preview: Standardize APIs for security automation. Security tooling integrates through standard APIs. Non-standard integrations are reduced.

documents.title: 6.2 Critical Process Automation
documents.official_text_preview: Automate critical security processes. Key security processes are automated. Manual gaps in security response are reduced.

documents.title: 6.3 Machine Learning
documents.official_text_preview: Apply machine learning to security operations. ML augments detection and response. Anomalies are detected faster.

documents.title: 6.4 Artificial Intelligence
documents.official_text_preview: Apply AI to security orchestration and response. AI-assisted response is integrated. Response latency is reduced.

documents.title: 6.5 Automated Decision Making
documents.official_text_preview: Automate policy-based security decisions. Decisions are automated within policy bounds. Manual policy enforcement gaps are reduced.

documents.title: 6.6 Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR)
documents.official_text_preview: Orchestrate automated security response. SOAR integrates security tooling. Incident response is coordinated automatically.

documents.title: 6.7 Security Operations Center (SOC) Optimization
documents.official_text_preview: Optimize SOC workflows for zero trust. SOC processes support zero trust operations. Operational blind spots are reduced.

documents.title: 7.1 Log All Traffic (Network, Data, Apps, User)
documents.official_text_preview: Log traffic across all zero trust pillars. Comprehensive logging is available for analysis. Unlogged critical traffic is remediated.

documents.title: 7.2 Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)
documents.official_text_preview: Centralize security event management. Events are correlated in a SIEM. Uncorrelated critical events are escalated.

documents.title: 7.3 Common Security and Risk Analytics
documents.official_text_preview: Share analytics across the enterprise. Risk analytics are common and reusable. Siloed analytics are integrated.

documents.title: 7.4 User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA)
documents.official_text_preview: Analyze user and entity behavior. Behavioral analytics inform access decisions. Anomalous behavior triggers response.

documents.title: 7.5 Threat Intelligence Integration
documents.official_text_preview: Integrate threat intelligence into analytics. Threat intelligence enriches detections. Known threats are blocked faster.

documents.title: 7.6 Automated Dynamic Policies
documents.official_text_preview: Dynamically update policies from analytics. Policies adapt based on analytics. Stale policies are automatically updated.
